gap_fill_decisions: momentum arm is the registered F07; reversal arm pre-declared as F07R so both signs of the same trigger are reported (no post-hoc choice of sign)
stop scale uses ATR14 of 5m bars (about 3-4 pips) instead of 1m ATR (about 1 pip), which would sit inside the spread; outcome horizon 15 min (registry set)
missing_in_source: position-sizing rule (supplied by the EUR 500 capital model of this task)
single outcome horizon (registry lists candidate sets only)
cost model (supplied by the shared harness)
whether the arm is momentum or reversal (the name lists both)
name: FAST -- Short-Horizon Momentum / Reversal

exits: time exit at the first 1m boundary >= entry fill + 15 min
operationalization.rule: z_move_5 = (C_t - C_{t-5}) / ATR14(1m). MOMENTUM arm (official F07): LONG if z_move_5 >= +3.0 and the last 1m bar closed up; SHORT mirror. Pre-declared companion arm F07R (REVERSAL mirror): identical trigger, opposite direction; reported but not promotable on its own.

source_registry.note: most cost-sensitive of the seven families -- explicitly flagged as the one most likely to be rejected once a real cost model is applied
source_registry.original_signal_definition: CONCEPT ONLY: the shortest-horizon sibling of F01/F02 (e.g. 1m-5m lookback, 5m-15m outcome) -- kept as a distinct family rather than a parameter of F01/F02 because its cost sensitivity and data-quality requirements (Section 6/9) are qualitatively different at this timescale.
source_registry.required_data: 1-minute canonical FX bars (least tolerance for any base-frequency coarser than 1-minute).
